items.stem: What is the minimum step structure for a competency agent?

options.text: At least 3 discrete steps beyond simple retrieval, including at least one thinking or transformation step.
One retrieval step and one summary step.
Any number of steps, as long as one writes to a system.
Constrain the agent to a well-defined set of content sources with clear instructions on what it can and cannot answer.
Prevent the agent from calling any external tools.
Force the agent to answer every question asked.

items.stem: Which memory setting is the default for formatting and cleanup steps?
What is the stated model selection strategy?

options.text: Small and fast models for simple transforms; larger models only where reasoning clearly benefits the outcome.
Always use the largest available model.
Always use the smallest available model.

items.stem: Which requirement needs a loop rather than branching?

options.text: Applying the same treatment to every item in a returned collection.
Taking a different path for approved versus rejected records.
Starting the agent when a document changes.
